case.summary: Case HHG-004 was opened after the fraud probability reached 0.30 based on a single signal indicating possible suspicious activity on card 21429_0, which showed 216 transactions with varied recent amounts. Evidence review found no clear fraud pattern, the customer did not respond to a validation request, and policy documentation outlined standard actions for allow/decline decisions. After verifying with the customer, issuing a warning, monitoring the card, and declining pending authorizations pending verification, the case was closed as legitimate with no fraud evidence.
